newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH SKODA AUTO SEES END-DECADE OUTPUT AT 500,000.
newsitem.headline: CZECH SKODA AUTO SEES END-DECADE OUTPUT AT 500,000.

text.p: Czech car maker Skoda Automobilova a.s., a unit of Germany's Volkswagen AG , said on Thursday that annual output should rise to 500,000 units by the end of the century, from 263,193 in 1996.
"Half a million Skoda automobiles (per year) by the end of the decade is a realistic target," outgoing Vice-Chairman Volkhard Kohler said in a statement.
Skoda said that it expected output to rise by 30 percent this year, after last year's increase of 26.3 percent increase.
In the first two months of 1997, output rose 10 percent, year on year, to 50,374 units, the statement said.
Skoda posted a net profit of 163 million crowns in 1996, after a 1.621 billion net loss in 1995.
